labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "Each moved ticket's new agent is notified as for a single assignment" and "the agent named in the ONCALL environment variable is notified", and reusing the existing outbox and worker is how those notifications are delivered.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "A ticket is escalated at most once, even across restarts of the service."

labels.label: implied
labels.why: The bulk move and the escalation pass must not race with single assignments or each other, or tickets could be moved or escalated wrongly; a single-process synchronous store provides that safety without adding anything.

labels.label: implied
labels.why: Bulk moves and escalations that silently fail to notify would hide unassigned urgent tickets from whoever must act, so the existing audit and outbox reports need to cover them.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "ESCALATE_AFTER_MINUTES minutes (an environment variable, default 60)" and "without ONCALL nothing is escalated"; validating those values at startup is rigour on requested configuration.
